structuredContent.body:
Delivers A-REMOTE-004 bounded typed storage/recovery redesign and isolated fake-backend qualification.

Inputs: coordination main `531aa8cd0435ed9813ab39664888992583df0d28`; A-REMOTE-003 `74e4f1a681cd589625aff63e91f917076cc22586` / PR #8, preserved and unmerged. Owner authorization commit: `a0f6d8a672e0e9c016fab7d98bd89adeb08d6bc6`.

Includes the authorized task, report, complete supported projection, reproducible prototype/tests, size and fault evidence, prior handoff byte-for-byte archives, and complete new REMOTE handoff.

Validation: 12 tests PASS, 7,805 counted checks, 562 recorded scenarios. Maximum legal encoded state 6,383 bytes; resolution growth reserve 796 bytes; conservative raw record reserve 15,510 bytes. Current 24 KiB NVS is conditionally plausible under small ideal other occupancy, but the model fails at 2?4 KiB occupancy. Actual capacity remains BLOCKED pending backend/physical qualification.

Newest-intent integrity requires a separately qualified durable monotonic root service and ordered durable records; hashes/readback are not anti-rollback proof. The A-003 stale-valid-anchor counterexample is preserved/reproduced. Default unqualified backend blocks; recovery never emits. Physical newest-head, write ordering, ambiguity, quota/GC, latency and endurance guarantees remain unqualified.

No production Core integration, live NVS or credentials, partition/configuration edits, firmware build, hardware flashing, Native API implementation, TUNER changes or common-gate approval. Hardware NOT RUN. READY FOR REVIEW; production integration BLOCKED.
